pyqgis_plugin.name: SEILAPLAN
pyqgis_plugin.description: Seillinien-Layoutplaner — A cable road layout planner
pyqgis_plugin.about: [DE] SEILAPLAN ermöglicht die einfache und effiziente Planung von Seillinien unter Berücksichtigung topografischer Gegebenheiten. Die implementierte Berechnungsmethode basiert auf der Methode von Zweifel (1960) und beschreibt die Kettenlinie, unter Annahme einer beidseitig fixierten Verankerung des Tragseils. Dieses QGIS-Plugin ist ein Hilfsmittel. Jede Lösung muss vor Umsetzung durch eine geschulte Fachperson geprüft werden. Jegliche Haftung wird im Rahmen der GNU General Public Licence Version 2 oder neuere ausgeschlossen (www.gnu.org/licenses). *** [EN] SEILAPLAN enables simple and efficient planning of cable roads, taking topographical conditions into account. The implemented calculation method is based on the method developed by Zweifel (1960) and describes the catenary, assuming that the skyline is anchored at both ends. This QGIS plugin is a tool. Every solution must be checked by a trained specialist before implementation. Any liability is excluded under the GNU General Public License Version 2 or later (www.gnu.org/licenses). *** Dokumentation: https://seilaplan.wsl.ch *** Bont, Moll, Ramstein, Frutig, Heinimann, Schweier (2022). Introducing Seilaplan, a QGIS plugin for cable road layout planning. Croatian Journal of Forest Engineering, 2022. https://doi.org/10.5552/crojfe.2022.1824
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Bont, Moll, Ramstein, Frutig, Heinimann, Schweier

pyqgis_plugin.name: Script Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: A PyQGIS script manager for safe execution, debugging, and automation. Features a visual browser with an integrated output console, automatic file monitoring, script validation, and full Qt5/Qt6 support.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Script Manager provides a environment for managing, executing, and debugging PyQGIS scripts. Its core features include: a visual script browser with an integrated console to capture print() statements and errors in real-time; a safe execution environment that prevents script failures from crashing QGIS; pre-execution validation to warn against risky code; automatic file monitoring for instant reloading; and a quick access menu for routine tasks. pyqgis_plugin.name: FuzzyAttributes
pyqgis_plugin.description: FR: FuzzyAttributes V2 étend le plugin original en intégrant trois nouveaux modules pour les données raster et catégorielles. Il permet de convertir des attributs numériques, textuels ou des rasters en valeurs floues (degrés d’appartenance entre 0 et 1) selon plusieurs fonctions d’appartenance : linéaire croissante/décroissante, triangulaire, trapézoïdale, sigmoïde (S et Z) et gaussienne. Les nouveaux modules comprennent : Fuzzy Aggregation (agrégation floue d’attributs flous), FuzzyRaster (transformation floue directe de rasters), Raster Aggregation (agrégation floue de rasters) et Classes → Fuzzy (reclassement de rasters catégoriels en valeurs floues). L’interface graphique facilite la configuration, affiche des exemples visuels et propose une aide intégrée multilingue (FR, EN, ES, PT). EN: FuzzyAttributes V2 extends the original plugin with three new modules for raster and categorical data. It converts numeric, textual, or raster attributes into fuzzy membership values (degrees between 0 and 1) using several membership functions: increasing/decreasing linear, triangular, trapezoidal, sigmoid (S and Z), and Gaussian. The new modules include: Fuzzy Aggregation (fuzzy aggregation of attributes), FuzzyRaster (fuzzy transformation of rasters), Raster Aggregation (fuzzy combination of rasters), and Classes → Fuzzy (reclassification of categorical rasters into fuzzy values). The interface provides easy configuration, visual examples, and multilingual help (FR, EN, ES, PT).
pyqgis_plugin.about: FR: FuzzyAttributes est un plugin QGIS permettant de convertir des attributs numériques, textuels ou des rasters en valeurs floues selon plusieurs fonctions d’appartenance (linéaire, trapézoïdale, triangulaire, sigmoïde, gaussienne). Il inclut quatre modules : Fuzzy Aggregation, FuzzyRaster, Raster Aggregation et Classes → Fuzzy. L’interface graphique offre des exemples visuels, une aide intégrée et la gestion multilingue. EN: FuzzyAttributes is a QGIS plugin for converting numeric, textual, or raster data into fuzzy values using common membership functions. It includes four modules: Fuzzy Aggregation, FuzzyRaster, Raster Aggregation, and Classes → Fuzzy. The interface provides visual previews, built-in help, and multilingual support.

User-friendly: Intuitive for QGIS users, with clear functionality, good defaults, and thorough documentation.
Seamless integration: Leverages QGIS and WNTR capabilities, complementing existing QGIS tools, algorithms, and plugins.
Robust: Focused on reliable, well-tested features.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TrailScan
pyqgis_plugin.description: Deep learning-based segmentation of skid trails from airborne LiDAR data
pyqgis_plugin.about: Note: On first installation TrailScan downloads additional Python packages (rasterio, laspy, scipy and others). This can take several minutes, during which QGIS may become unresponsive - please save your work before installing and wait until the installation has finished. TrailScan is a QGIS plugin for automatic mapping of skid trails from Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) data in forest environments. Input: ALS point clouds (.las / .laz) from aircraft, helicopters, or UAVs. Workflow: 1. Preprocessing – Convert the point cloud into a normalized multi-band raster (DTM, CHM, MRM, VDI). 2. Inference – Apply the pretrained TrailScan deep learning model to generate a probability map ("Trailmap"). The trained TrailScan model is available at https://doi.org/10.25625/GEIP6T. Output: A georeferenced raster ("Trailmap" with values 0–1) indicating the likelihood of skid trail presence, ready for further GIS analysis.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: HAWK Forest Monitoring Lab (Tanja Kempen, Mathias Gröbe, Maximilian Freudenberg, Paul Magdon)

pyqgis_plugin.name: brdrQ
pyqgis_plugin.description: brdrQ, a QGIS-plugin for aligning thematic borders to reference borders, using the brdr-library.
pyqgis_plugin.about: brdrQ is a QGIS-plugin that assists in aligning geometric boundaries to reference boundaries. This is an important task in geographic data management to enhance data quality. In the context of geographic data management, it is important to have accurate and consistent boundaries for a variety of applications such as calculating areas, analyzing spatial relationships, and visualizing and querying geographic information. When creating geographic data, it is often more efficient to derive boundaries from existing reference data rather than collecting new data in the field. brdrQ can be used to align boundaries from new data to reference data, ensuring that the boundaries are accurate and consistent. brdrQ uses brdr-python-library for these calculations. The plugin can be used for all regions with a projected CRS (units:meter), but there are some extra functionalities to support the on-the-fly download of reference-data for Flanders (GRB). (The plugin is tested for Windows. Usage for Linux and Mac might work but is not tested)

pyqgis_plugin.name: istat_confini_plugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin per scaricare confini amministrativi ISTAT e griglia di popolazione 2021 su standard europeo
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Questo plugin permette di scaricare direttamente i confini amministrativi italiani dal sito ISTAT e la griglia di popolazione 2021 su standard europeo (Eurostat). Supporta regioni, province, comuni e ripartizioni geografiche sia in versione generalizzata che non generalizzata. Include anche la griglia di popolazione del Censimento 2021 con 13 variabili censuarie secondo il Regolamento UE 1799/2018. I dati sono disponibili dal 2022 al 2026 e vengono scaricati direttamente dai server ISTAT. EN:This plugin allows direct download of Italian administrative boundaries from the ISTAT website and the 2021 population grid on European standard (Eurostat). It supports regions, provinces, municipalities and geographical divisions in both generalized and non-generalized versions. It also includes the 2021 Census population grid with 13 census variables according to EU Regulation 1799/2018. Data is available from 2022 to 2026 and downloaded directly from ISTAT servers.
Funzionalità principali: - Download automatico dei file ZIP da ISTAT - Selezione tra 4 tipi di confini amministrativi - Griglia di popolazione 2021 (celle 1 km², EPSG:3035) - Download multipli simultanei (confini + griglia) - Opzione per versione generalizzata o dettagliata - Interfaccia con 3 tab organizzati - Caricamento automatico in QGIS - Interfaccia completamente in italiano - Barra di progresso durante il download - Gestione errori integrata - Possibilità di scaricare solo griglia popolazione
Main features: - Automatic download of ZIP files from ISTAT - Selection between 4 types of administrative boundaries - 2021 population grid (1 km² cells, EPSG:3035) - Simultaneous multiple downloads (boundaries + grid) - Option for generalized or detailed version - Interface with 3 organized tabs - Automatic loading in QGIS - Fully Italian interface - Progress bar during download - Integrated error handling - Option to download only population grid
Requirements: Internet connection for downloading data from ISTAT servers. The plugin uses QGIS native network manager (QgsNetworkAccessManager) which respects proxy settings and provides better integration with QGIS environment. No external dependencies required - works with standard QGIS installation. IT: Requisiti: Connessione internet per scaricare i dati dai server ISTAT. Il plugin usa il gestore di rete nativo di QGIS (QgsNetworkAccessManager) che rispetta le impostazioni proxy e offre migliore integrazione con l'ambiente QGIS. Nessuna dipendenza esterna richiesta - funziona con installazione standard di QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: OpenRES: Open Riverine Ecosystem Synthesis
pyqgis_plugin.description: A QGIS plugin for automated extraction of hydrogeomorphic features to support Functional Process Zone classification of river networks.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
OpenRES is a QGIS plugin designed to support Riverine Ecosystem Synthesis (RES)–based analyses by enabling the systematic, reproducible delineation and characterization of Functional Process Zones (FPZs) along river networks.
RES emphasizes that river corridors are organized as hierarchically nested, longitudinally discontinuous patches whose geomorphic structure constrains hydrologic and ecological processes. In practice, however, applying RES concepts across entire river networks is often limited by labor-intensive GIS workflows, inconsistent metric definitions, and difficulty scaling analyses beyond individual reaches.
OpenRES addresses these limitations by automating the extraction of hydrogeomorphic variables that define FPZ structure for user-defined river segments (typically 5–10 km). Core tools quantify elevation (ELE), precipitation (PRE), geology (GEO), valley width (VW), valley floor width (VFW), the valley width–to–valley floor width ratio (RAT), valley side slopes (LVS, RVS, MVS), down-valley slope (DVS), channel sinuosity (SIN), channel belt width (CBW), and channel belt sinuosity (LCS, RCS, CBS). OpenRES also includes geomorphology utility tools to generate essential input layers such as valley floor polygons, microsheds, valley boundaries, and channel belts.
The metrics produced can be evaluated individually or integrated using hierarchical, unsupervised classification approaches to delineate FPZs — repeatable hydrogeomorphic patches that organize physical habitat templates and ecological processes along river corridors. By enabling network-scale, standardized FPZ characterization, OpenRES facilitates comparative analyses, cross-system synthesis, and management applications grounded in RES theory

pyqgis_plugin.name: Attribute Copier
pyqgis_plugin.description: Copy attributes from a source object to target objects (supports cross-layer copying).
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin allows you to copy attributes from a source object and paste them into selected target objects.
- Supports copying attributes between TWO DIFFERENT vector layers (if field names and field types match). - Safer editing: Pasting activates Edit Mode. You can review changes, Undo (Ctrl+Z), and explicitly Save or Discard edits.
How to use: 1. Select a source layer and verify fields. 2. Select ONE source object and click 'Copy attributes'. 3. (Optional) Switch to a different target layer. 4. Select target objects and click 'Paste attributes'. 5. Save edits (Layer -> Save Layer Edits) or Undo/Discard if needed.

This helps teams always use the latest version of tools without manual updates or user notifications.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoBasis_Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Einfaches Finden und Einfügen ausgewählter freier Geodienste // Easy finding and insertion of selected free geoservices
pyqgis_plugin.about:
(04.06.2026, v2.1.1) Das Plugin vereinfacht das Finden und Einfügen ausgewählter WMS-, WMTS-, WFS-, WCS-, und VectorTiles-Dienste aus den Open Data Portalen der Landesvermessungsämter sowie von Hintergrundkarten (OSM, Basemap.de) zum aktuellen View. Ziel ist es, eine deutschlandweite Sammlung der GeoBasisdaten mit aktuellen Links anzubieten. Mehr Informationen zum GeoBasis_Loader inkl. Status, Versionshistorie und FAQs auf https://geobasisloader.de/ zu finden.
Hinweis: Die Verfügbarkeit, die Symbolisierung der Inhalte sowie die Sichtbarkeit nach Maßstäben hängen ausschließlich vom Datenanbieter ab. Es gelten die vom Anbieter beschriebenen Nutzungsbedingungen. Bei einigen Themen wird die Sichtbarkeit nach Maßstäben zusätzlich über das Plugin eingestellt und kann bei Bedarf mit QGIS-Bordmitteln geändert werden. Die vom Diensteanbieter festgelegten Maßstabsgrenzen sind davon unbetroffen. Die in diesem Plugin genutzten Links (URLs) auf die Dienste der Anbieter werden mit größtmöglicher Sorgfalt recherchiert und implementiert. Fehler im Bearbeitungsvorgang sind dennoch nicht auszuschließen. Hinweise und Korrekturen senden Sie bitte an news@geoobserver.de?subject=GeoBasis_Loader_Input Eine Haftung für die Verfügbarkeit, Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität dieser Links kann trotz sorgfältiger Prüfung nicht übernommen werden. Das gilt auch für eventuelle Schäden oder Konsequenzen, die durch die direkte oder indirekte Nutzung der angebotenen Inhalte entstehen.
--------------------------------------
The plugin makes it easier to find and insert selected WMS-, WMTS-, WFS-, WCS-, and VectorTiles services from the open data portals of the state surveying offices and background maps (OSM, Basemap.de) for the current view. The aim is to provide a Germany-wide collection of geodata with up-to-date links. More information about GeoBasis_Loader incl. status, version history and FAQs on https://geobasisloader.de/
Note: The availability, the symbolisation of the content and the visibility according to standards depend exclusively on the data provider. The terms of use described by the provider apply. For some themes, the visibility by scale is also set via the plugin and can be changed using QGIS on-board resources if required. The scale limits set by the service provider are not affected by this. The links (URLs) to the providers' services used in this plugin are researched and implemented with the greatest possible care. However, errors in the editing process cannot be ruled out. Please send any comments and corrections to news@geoobserver.de?subject=GeoBasis_Loader_Input Despite careful checking, no liability can be accepted for the availability, accuracy, completeness and topicality of these links. This also applies to any damage or consequences arising from the direct or indirect use of the content provided.

pyqgis_plugin.name: BeachBall
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin creates beachball to represent focal mechanisms from strike, dip, and rake.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin read the strike, dip, and rake information and build the corresponding beachball for representing the focal mechanisms. Obspy module is used for producing the SVGs. Images are coloured according to the kinematics, following the classification of Zoback (1992). Colors can be changed from the UI. The plugin also add P-T-B attitudes and SHmax azimuth in the attribute table. Percentage of DC, CLVD, ISO can be added as fields for the representation.

pyqgis_plugin.name: geo_search
pyqgis_plugin.description: Advanced map search system for QGIS. Supports cadastral lot ("tiban"), owner name, and general attribute search. Results are shown in per-layer tabs with configurable display fields, paging, and map theme switching. Includes a UI for per-tab settings, theme selection ("selectTheme"), and an "additive display" mode to overlay search results. Compatible with QGIS 3.x, Qt5/Qt6.\n\nQGIS用の地図検索システム。地番・所有者名・属性検索に対応し、結果はレイヤごとにタブ表示・ページング・表示フィールド選択が可能。タブごとの設定編集UI、マップテーマ切替（selectTheme）、追加表示モード（既存表示に重ねて検索結果を表示）を搭載。QGIS 3.x/Qt5/Qt6対応。
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin enables advanced map search in QGIS projects: lot-number, owner-name, and attribute-based search, with results shown in per-layer tabs. Features include:
- Per-tab configurable search fields and display fields (UI editable)
- Supports QGIS layers, files, and PostGIS databases
- Paging for large results
- Map theme switching per search (selectTheme, including "検索前" for restoring previous view)
- Additive display mode: overlay search results on current map
- Qt5/Qt6 compatible, QGIS 3.x supported
- Japanese/English UI and documentation

pyqgis_plugin.about: <b>OBM Connect</b> is a QGIS plugin designed to allow users to seamlessly connect to the OpenBioMaps database from within the QGIS environment.<br><br>Its main functionalities include:<ul><li><b>User Authentication:</b> Enables users to log in directly to their OpenBioMaps account.</li> <li><b>Spatial Data Access:</b> Allows authenticated users to conveniently browse, select, and load spatial layers and datasets from OpenBioMaps into QGIS.</li> <li><b>Integrated Workflow:</b> Streamlines data-import workflows for biodiversity, ecological, and environmental projects by providing direct access to official OpenBioMaps repositories.</li></ul>This plugin is ideal for researchers, ecologists, and GIS specialists who regularly work with biodiversity and environmental spatial data, ensuring efficient access to up-to-date datasets while maintaining secure credential management.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Gestion parcelles forestières
pyqgis_plugin.description: Gestion de parcelles forestières, travaux, traitements, type essences arbres. Ce plugin permet la gestion complète de vos parcelles.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Ce plugin vous permet de gérer vos parcelles forestières, le type d'essences, les travaux et traitements faits ou en prévision, les coordonnées de vos voisins et une analyse statistique simple de vos parcelles. Un code couleur évolutif permet de différencier le type de plantations. Une configuration est nécessaire pour créer les champs et les codes couleurs dans votre table attributaire nécessaires au fonctionnement du plugin. Pour que celui-ci fonctionne il faut tout d'abord installer une couche cadastrale et s'assurer qu'elle comporte bien les champs : id, section, numéro et contenance. Le plugin la convertira au format Geopackage automatiquement. Lire le fichier d'aide LIRE AVANT. Le fichier d'aide est disponible en Français pour les francophones et en Anglais pour toutes les autres langues automatiquement. Compatibilité de la configuration du plugin avec les pays suivants : Luxembourg, Belgique, Suisse, Sénégal, Côte d’Ivoire, Bénin, Burkina Faso, Togo, Mali, Niger. Version compatible Qgis3 Qt5 et Qgis4 Qt6. Merci de vos retours. This plugin allows you to manage your forest plots, the type of tree species, the work and treatments carried out or planned, the contact details of your neighbors and a simple statistical analysis of your plots. Thanks to Pascal O. for his corrections for 1.5.6 . The help file is automatically available in French for French speakers and in English for all other languages.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Hotspot Analysis v3
pyqgis_plugin.description: Advanced detection of hotspots, coldspots, and spatial clusters. Implements Getis-Ord Gi, Local Moran’s I (Univariate), and Local Moran’s I (Bivariate) as native QGIS Processing algorithms for strategic analysis. QGIS 3.22/4.x and Model Designer compatible.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Hotspot Analysis v3: Advanced Spatial Cluster Detection
Transform your geographic data into strategic intelligence. This plugin provides robust tools to detect statistically significant patterns, such as crime hotspots, economic clusters or environmental anomalies.
Available Methods:
- Getis-Ord Gi:* Detection of significant hotspots (high-value clusters) and coldspots (low-value clusters). - Local Moran's I (Univariate): Identification of spatial clusters (HH/LL) and spatial outliers (HL/LH). - Bivariate Local Moran's I: Analysis of spatial correlation between two different variables.
Why use v3 4.0.0? Modernized by Abimael Cereda Junior, this version is not just a tool, but a scientific revision. It follows strict bibliographic standards (Anselin, Getis & Ord) to ensure that p-values and Z-scores are calculated correctly - fixing common issues with coldspot visibility and Gi* definitions found in other implementations.
Scientific & Didactic All parameters are transparent. Whether for professional consulting or academic research, this plugin is designed for those who need results they can explain and justify. Please read the full documentation (README/GitHub) for a deep dive into the methodology and parameter rationale.
Requirements: Uses libpysal and esda. Installation is usually automatic on QGIS 3.30+. For manual setup on Windows, use the OSGeo4W Shell: pip install libpysal esda.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Databricks DBSQL Connector
pyqgis_plugin.description: Connect QGIS to Databricks SQL warehouses and access geospatial data directly from Unity Catalog
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A QGIS plugin that provides direct connectivity to Databricks SQL warehouses, allowing you to load and display geospatial data from Unity Catalog tables directly in QGIS.
Features: - Direct Databricks SQL connection using personal access tokens - Full support for GEOGRAPHY and GEOMETRY data types - Live Layers: viewport-based auto-refresh for working with large datasets - Browser Panel integration for browsing catalogs, schemas, and tables - Custom SQL query support with automatic geometry detection - Automatic handling of mixed geometry types (creates separate layers) - Configurable layer naming with persistent settings - Genie Chat: ask questions about your data in natural language - Connection management with saved credentials - QGIS 3.x and 4.x compatible (Qt5 and Qt6)
Requirements: - Databricks SQL Warehouse access - Personal Access Token with appropriate permissions - Unity Catalog tables with GEOGRAPHY or GEOMETRY columns
Python Dependencies (installed automatically): - databricks-sql-connector>=3.5.0 (required)
For installation instructions and documentation, visit the GitHub repository. https://github.com/danny-db/qgis-databricks-connector

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoAI
pyqgis_plugin.description: GeoAI plugin for QGIS providing AI-powered geospatial analysis including tree segmentation (DeepForest), water segmentation (OmniWaterMask), Moondream vision-language model, Segment Anything (SAM1/SAM2/SAM3), semantic segmentation, and instance segmentation (Mask R-CNN).
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin provides AI-powered geospatial analysis tools:
Built-in Dependency Installer: - One-click installation of all AI dependencies - Automatic GPU detection (NVIDIA CUDA, Apple MPS)
Tree Segmentation (DeepForest): - Detect tree crowns, birds, livestock, nests, and dead trees using pretrained models - Run predictions on single images or large tiles with patch-based inference
Water Segmentation (OmniWaterMask): - Automated water body detection from satellite and aerial imagery - Output as raster or vector with optional OSM data integration
Moondream Vision-Language Model: - Caption: Generate descriptions of geospatial imagery - Query: Ask questions about images using natural language - Detect: Detect and locate objects with bounding boxes - Point: Locate specific objects with point markers
Segment Anything with SAM 3: - Segment objects using text prompts (e.g., "tree", "building", "road") - Segment using point prompts (foreground/background) or box prompts drawn on the map - Process multiple points interactively or from vector files/layers - Save results as raster (GeoTIFF) or vector (GeoPackage, Shapefile) with optional regularization
Semantic Segmentation: - Train custom segmentation models (U-Net, DeepLabV3+, FPN, etc.) - Run inference on raster imagery - Export results as vector or raster data
Instance Segmentation (Mask R-CNN): - Train Mask R-CNN models for instance-level object detection and segmentation - Run inference on raster imagery with vectorized output
Requires the geoai-py Python package and PyTorch. CUDA or MPS support recommended for optimal performance.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: geospatial,remote sensing,machine learning,segmentation,deep learning,ai,deepforest,instance segmentation,object detection,vision language model,moondream,samgeo,mask rcnn,water segmentation

pyqgis_plugin.name: SmartLineLabeler
pyqgis_plugin.description: SmartLineLabeler is a QGIS plugin that automatically creates clean, readable, stacked labels for overlapping line features—ideal for utilities, telecom cables, pipelines, and any dense linear network. It lets you interactively draw label positions and generates a dedicated label layer with customizable HTML-styled text for professional cartographic output.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
✨ Key Features - Stacked labels for overlapping lines: Automatically generates multi‑line label blocks for all features intersecting your drawn placement line.
- Interactive label placement: Draw a short “rubber band” line to define the exact position and angle of the label group.
- Dedicated label layer: Creates a temporary or permanent layer containing the generated labels, keeping your source data untouched.
- HTML-based label styling: Supports bold, color, multi-line formatting, and other HTML features for highly readable technical labels.
- Configurable attribute mapping: Choose which fields to include in the label and how they should be formatted.
- Ideal for utilities and infrastructure mapping: Works especially well for telecom cables, pipelines, fiber bundles, and other dense linear datasets.

pyqgis_plugin.name: plugin_translator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automatic generation and translation of .ts/.qm files for QGIS plugins using Google Translate. Translation of HTML files used by the plugin is also possible.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin automatically generates translation files (.ts) for a QGIS plugin, translates them using Google Translate and generate .qm files. You can choose the plugin's source language, so you no longer need to write your plugin text in English. It also allows you to translate an HTML file or an entire HTML folder. The plugin to be translated must have an i18n subfolder, and the strings must comply with Qt's automatic translation rules.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Bathymetrix-AI
pyqgis_plugin.description: An advanced Machine Learning pipeline for Satellite-Derived Bathymetry (SDB). Features ICESat-2 integration, In-Situ Data filtering, and Spatial Residual Stacking.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Bathymetrix-AI is a specialized QGIS research toolkit designed to derive high-precision bathymetry from corrected multispectral satellite imagery (such as Sentinel-2 L2A). By systematically integrating physics-based corrections with data-driven Machine Learning (ML), it overcomes the limitations of traditional Satellite-Derived Bathymetry (SDB).
The Core 5-Phase Workflow =========================
This system follows a strict, sequential pipeline from raw data to validated spatial models:
1. Advanced Pre-processing * Corrections: Physics-based sun-glint correction (Hedley). * Masking: Advanced water masking utilizing a 3-index consensus (NDWI, MNDWI, NWI). * Feature Engineering: Computation of physics-based Log-Ratio features. * Filtering: A customized Deep Water Filter optimized for downstream ML ingestion.
2. Robust Filtering * Removes noise and outliers using algorithms like Linear RANSAC, Least Squares (LS) Variance Fit, or Huber Variance Fit.
3. Global Auto-ML & Feature Analysis * Analysis: Optional feature correlation analysis via Automatic-RANSAC and Automatic-Random Forest. * Benchmarking: Competitive evaluation of 15+ ML algorithms (including XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost). * Optimization: Hyperparameter tuning via Random Search, Grid Search, or Bayesian optimization, validated through independent Spatial Cross-Validation.
4. Adaptive Refinement * Applies spatially localized corrections and residual analysis to identify and fix local biases.
5. Validation & Reporting * Conducts a rigorous, independent accuracy assessment on unseen test data to ensure model reliability.
Key Methodological References =============================
The toolkit's architecture is grounded in established hydrographic and computational research:
* Stumpf et al. (2003): Log-Ratio Algorithm for SDB inversion * Hedley et al. (2005): Physics-based sun-glint correction * Fischler & Bolles (1981): RANSAC algorithm foundation * Zhang et al. (2021): LS / Huber Variance Fit for ICESat-2 filtering * Alevizos (2020): Residual analysis & spatial refinement in shallow waters * Bergstra & Bengio (2012): Randomized search for hyperparameter optimization * Parrish et al. (2025): Analysis and assessment of global ICESat-2 bathymetry
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Developed for scientific research and hydrographic applications. Code architecture and documentation optimized in collaboration with Google Gemini AI.

pyqgis_plugin.about:
The verbeterdekaart.nl website allows users to submit corrections for digital maps of the Netherlands. pyqgis_plugin.name: 32BT Feature Navigation Toolbar

The plugin will load the selection and will zoom to and select the first feature. You can then use the navigation buttons to zoom to and select each individual feature. When active, other plugins can communicate with this plugin for conjoint operation. See homepage for details.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QspellinGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: A dock widget that allows you to check spelling of attribute data - hence (Q) Spell In GIS
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin is for Spell Checking your attribute data (and allows you to build a custom Personal Word List) - it builds a basic attribute form in a Dock window - text fields are editable and the plugin creates a custom Context Menu for spell checking. On Windows you can use pySpellChecker module. For Linux / Mac / WSL you can also use Enchant. If you are using pySpellChecker as the spelling library you can Bring Your Own Dictionary (i.e. import your own Word Frequency List, which you can create with pySpellChecker) and a custom British English dictionary is included. It is necessarily clunky because QGIS does not currently expose the python bindings to allow the native attribute forms to use this functionality. You can loop through features or use a custom identify tool to view each feature's attributes. When looping through each feature of a selected layer the canvas will Pan or Zoom to each feature. Plugin REQUIRES: pySpellChecker and optionally Enchant libraries - which can be loaded using pyEnchant or libenchant2 in your python installation.

pyqgis_plugin.name: FieldWatch Vectorizer

A free trial starts automatically on first use; a paid licence unlocks full access across all workflows. Learn more at https://usefieldwatch.com/

pyqgis_plugin.name: S57Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: FR:S57Manager est un plugin QGIS dédié à l’import, la gestion et l’affichage des données marines ENC (S-57).Il permet d’importer automatiquement des fichiers ENC (.000) vers une base GeoPackage ou PostGIS, d’organiser les couches par thèmes, d’appliquer des styles adaptés et de gérer les échelles d’affichage.Le plugin intègre également un module NOAA permettant de parcourir le catalogue officiel ENC, de filtrer les cellules par purpose, échelle et emprise du canevas, puis de les télécharger et importer directement dans QGIS.S57Manager prend en charge le multilingue (FR/EN/ES/PT) et regroupe plusieurs outils ENC dans une interface unique.EN:S57Manager is a QGIS plugin dedicated to the import, management and display of marine ENC (S-57) data.It allows automatic import of ENC files (.000) into a GeoPackage or PostGIS database, thematic layer organization, predefined styling and scale-based visibility management.The plugin also includes a NOAA module to browse the official ENC catalog, filter cells by purpose, scale and map extent, and download and import them directly into QGIS.S57Manager supports multiple languages (FR/EN/ES/PT) and provides a unified interface for ENC-related tools.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Plugin QGIS dédié à l’import, la gestion et l’affichage des données marines ENC (S-57).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Hydrological Analysis Stream Network
pyqgis_plugin.description: Algorithm for hydrological analysis that generates the drainage network from a digital terrain model (DTM)
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Algorithm for hydrological analysis that generates the drainage network from a digital terrain model (DTM).

pyqgis_plugin.name: 32BT Feature Annotation Toolbar
pyqgis_plugin.description: Quickly add and manage annotated pointfeatures in a dedicated layer.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin provides a toolbar to quickly pin captions to locations of interest. It features predefined and customizable captions that can be selected when you pin a location, and allows additional information to be entered. Markers can be placed quickly and easily near points-of-interest, and are accompanied by a note which is visible in the marker's label. The markerslayer is a plain pointlayer which can be exported and manipulated by the usual methods, and customized to taste. The process is applicable in many situations, and is easily adaptable to various workflows.
The plugin also features managementfunctions to group and categorize your workload in batches. You can quickly start a session which generates a dedicated folder with geojson items and includes a simple, accessible logfile. Features can additionally be locked as active, while being assigned to separate groups if necessary. When features are no longer needed, they can be archived.

pyqgis_plugin.name: MoveRaster
pyqgis_plugin.description: Move raster and vector layers by clicking on the map / Sposta raster e layer vettoriali cliccando sulla mappa
pyqgis_plugin.about: Move raster and vector layers together by clicking a destination point on the map. Supports GeoTIFF (internal geotransform) and world files (PNG/JPG/TIFF). Features: move selected geometries only, undo support up to 10 levels, built-in tutorial, language selector (IT/EN).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Clip Raster Layout
pyqgis_plugin.description: Clip raster layers using polygon masks with optional topographic profile generation. Features batch clipping, interactive polygon drawing, section profiles with elevation charts, and automatic layer management.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A comprehensive QGIS plugin for topographic analysis that provides:
- Batch Raster Clipping: Clip multiple raster layers (DEM, DTM, orthophotos) using a polygon mask - Interactive Polygon Drawing: Draw clip polygons directly on the map canvas - Topographic Sections: Create cross-section lines with automatic labeling (A-B, C-D, etc.) - Elevation Profiles: Generate matplotlib elevation charts along section lines - Auto-refresh Layer Lists: Layer lists update automatically when layers are added/removed - Built-in Tutorial: Interactive help system with usage instructions
Compatible with QGIS 3.x (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Quick VRT Imagery Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Loads satellite images from Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API quickly
pyqgis_plugin.about: Plugin for searching and loading satellite imagery via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API. It lists pre-configured compositions and loads images as VRT. Supports Sentinel-2 and Landsat collections with multiple band compositions (True Color, False Color NIR/SWIR, Agriculture, Geology, Urban, Bathymetric, and more). Compatible with QGIS 3.x (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6).

pyqgis_plugin.name: SITG
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin facilitant l'utilisation des services du Système d'Informations du Territoire du Canton de Genève (SITG) dans QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin preconfigures QGIS with various resources of the Système d'Information du Territoire à Genève (SITG): background maps, raster and vector geoservices, with or without e-demarches account. It is highly recommended to all users of the SITG (both for those working inside the administration and the general public).
---
Ce plugin permet de préconfigurer QGIS avec les resources du Système d'Information du Territoire à Genève (SITG): fonds de plan, geoservices rasters et vectoriels, avec ou sans authentification e-demarches. Son installation est recommandée aux utilisateurs réguliers du SITG dans QGIS, tant en interne de l'administration qu'en externe.

pyqgis_plugin.name: WFS Catasto Download Particelle BBox
pyqgis_plugin.description: Download particelle catastali dal WFS dell'Agenzia delle Entrate tramite BBox, selezione poligono, linea con buffer o layer di punti.
pyqgis_plugin.about: WFS Catasto Download Particelle BBox - Plugin per QGIS che consente di scaricare le particelle catastali dal servizio WFS dell'Agenzia delle Entrate (INSPIRE). Quattro modalita' di selezione dell'area di interesse: 1) Disegna BBox: clicca due punti sulla mappa per disegnare un rettangolo di download. 2) Seleziona Poligono: clicca su un poligono esistente per estrarne il bounding box. 3) Seleziona Linea: clicca su una linea e crea un buffer personalizzabile (0-100m) per scaricare le particelle che lo intersecano. 4) Seleziona Punti: clicca su un layer di punti (o direttamente in mappa) per scaricare le particelle che contengono i punti. Supporta selezione parziale e auto-riproiezione UTM per CRS geografici. Opzione "Espandi riferimento catastale": estrae dal campo NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE i campi sezione, foglio, allegato e sviluppo (formato CCCCZFFFFAS). Supporta download multi-tile con progress bar, deduplicazione feature e filtro spaziale. Compatibile con QGIS 4 (Qt6/PyQt6). --- EN: A QGIS plugin for downloading cadastral parcels from the Italian Revenue Agency (Agenzia delle Entrate) WFS INSPIRE service. Three selection modes: draw BBox, select polygon, select line with customizable buffer (0-100m). Optional expansion of NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE into section, sheet, attachment and development fields. Supports multi-tile download with progress bar, feature deduplication and spatial filtering. DISCLAIMER: Please use this plugin responsibly. Massive or repeated downloads may overload the WFS service of the Italian Revenue Agency, causing disruptions for all users.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Terrascope
pyqgis_plugin.description: Search and visualize Terrascope STAC API data with time slider and time series plotting.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Terrascope QGIS Plugin provides tools for searching, loading, and analyzing Earth observation data from the Terrascope STAC API.
Features: - Search Terrascope STAC collections with spatial, temporal, and cloud cover filters - Load Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) directly into QGIS via /vsicurl/ - Time slider for stepping through multi-temporal raster layers - Interactive time series plotting by clicking map locations - OAuth2 authentication with automatic token refresh - Export time series data to CSV and save plots as images

pyqgis_plugin.name: ClickAttributeEditor
pyqgis_plugin.description: Click a feature to edit a chosen attribute, or drag a freehand area to bulk update multiple features.
pyqgis_plugin.about: ClickAttributeEditor is a QGIS plugin for fast attribute editing directly from the map canvas. A quick click edits one clicked feature, while click-and-drag draws a freehand area and updates all intersecting features in bulk. SHIFT + right-click changes the target field. The plugin is intended for simple, fast manual attribute editing workflows.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Slope Stability Analysis
pyqgis_plugin.description: A geotechnical engineering tool for 2D slope stability analysis within QGIS. It implements Bishop's Simplified Method to calculate the Factor of Safety (FS) for circular slip surfaces. Features include 1. Automated grid search for critical slip surfaces. 2. Support for multi-layer geology (Polygon layers with cohesion, phi, unit_weight). 3. Pore pressure calculation via custom Water Table layers (LineString). 4. Pseudo-static seismic analysis (Kh). 5. Test data(geo model layer: testdata_geomodel.geojson, water level layer:testdata_water_level_event.geojson) included.6. Shapely and NumPy libraries (Included in standard QGIS installations).Designed for civil engineers and geologists to perform rapid safety assessments directly on GIS geometry.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This program was developed with the assistance of Gemini and is a QGIS plugin. It features dual-mode analysis: a complete loop including "General" and "Event" modes. Users can select the geological model layer and groundwater level layer, and execute the program after inputting seismic coefficients. It will list all possible failure surfaces and their respective safety factors (FS).
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: 聚禾工程顧問有限公司

pyqgis_plugin.name: Kumoy
pyqgis_plugin.description: Turn your QGIS into cloud-native
pyqgis_plugin.about: Kumoy lets you seamlessly push your QGIS projects to the web, safely manage data, and enable efficient teamwork.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Geology tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Geology Tools offers a collection of plugins that simplify workflows in geology, hydrogeology, and seismic microzonation
pyqgis_plugin.about:
The following is a summary of the main modules and their functionalities:
GEOLOGY MAPPING 1. The Geology from points and lines Tool automates the creation of geological maps. - Workflow: The user draws geological contact lines to form closed polygons and places points with geological attributes (formation codes, lithology, etc.) inside them. - Automation: The algorithm cleans duplicate geometries, creates polygons from the line network, and transfers the attributes from the points to the resulting polygons. - Output: Produces topologically clean geological polygons and contact lines ready for GIS analysis.
HYDROLOGY 2. The Hydrological Analysis Stream Network (HASN) Module utilizes an integrated approach, leveraging GRASS GIS and SAGA GIS algorithms for robust watershed analysis. - Terrain Correction: It uses the Wang & Liu algorithm to fill sinks in Digital Terrain Models (DTM), ensuring a hydrologically correct surface. - Flow & Indices: It calculates drainage directions and flow accumulation to derive the Topographic Wetness Index (TWI), which identifies areas prone to saturation and runoff - Stream Delineation: The tool generates a vector stream network from the DTM, offering both a raw version for analysis and a "smooth" version for better cartographic visualization.
SEISMIC MICROZONATION This section includes tools for evaluating ground stability and seismic risk: 3. Lateral Spreading Analysis (LSA): Identifies horizontal soil movement risks during earthquakes by crossing the Liquefaction Index (IL)with terrain slope percentages. It classifies areas into Respect Zones (RZ), Susceptibility Zones (SZ), or Low Susceptibility Zones (Z0). 4. Seismic Microzonazion Morphological Analysis (SMMA): Identifies areas with slopes > 15° within seismic zones. This is critical because steep morphological gradients can amplify seismic waves and increase the risk of seismic-caused landslides.

pyqgis_plugin.name: CLC2Manning
pyqgis_plugin.description: Calcula la rugosidad de Manning de CORINE 2018 y la recorta por un área de interés para flujos de trabajo de modelado hidráulico.
pyqgis_plugin.about: CLC2Manning es un complemento de QGIS que asigna valores de rugosidad de Manning a los polígonos de CORINE Land Cover 2018. Permite cargar datos de CORINE desde un GeoPackage, seleccionar un Área de Interés haciendo clic en cualquier polígono del mapa, recortar CORINE a esa AOI, asignar valores de Manning según la clasificación CODE_18, calcular áreas de polígonos y, opcionalmente, heredar la simbología original de CORINE. Está diseñado para aplicaciones hidráulicas e hidrológicas, como estudios de inundaciones HEC-RAS. Por el momento sólo disponible para España Peninsular.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Pedro Ivar y Hugo Alejandro Bohorquez Aliaga Villafuerte

pyqgis_plugin.name: Geochemistry Plotting Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create spider diagrams, discrimination diagrams, and custom XY plots for geochemical data
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A simple geochemistry plotting tool for QGIS that creates: - Chondrite or Primitive Mantle normalized spider diagrams (REE + trace elements) - Tectonic discrimination diagrams (Pearce, Meschede, Wilson, Cox et al.) - Custom XY plots with user-defined element/oxide ratios
Developed for UWA EART3343 Lab exercises.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Label on a Cable - KelTech IoE
pyqgis_plugin.description: LOC QGIS plugin for automated generation, synchronisation, and management of infrastructure labels.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Authenticate to LOC, select a Location, and automatically generate infrastructure labels directly from your QGIS designs — eliminating manual label creation. The plugin enables bidirectional data flow between QGIS and LOC. Pull high-accuracy field data captured by engineers using mobile devices or GNSS receivers to update asset positions in your GIS project. Push bulk attribute updates (such as cable lengths or metadata) from QGIS back into LOC to keep your digital records aligned with real-world installations. Designed to significantly accelerate labelling workflows while improving spatial accuracy and data consistency across design and field operations.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Open NSPD Maps
pyqgis_plugin.description: Охват окна на сайте NSPD
pyqgis_plugin.about: Этот плагин открывает текущий охват карты на сайте NSPD простым нажатием кнопки. Связь в telegram: https://t.me/russofed

pyqgis_plugin.name: SIOSE2Manning
pyqgis_plugin.description: Calcula la rugosidad de Manning a partir de SIOSE AR (T_COMBINADA - ID_COBERTURA_MAX) y la recorta por un Área de Interés georeferenciada para flujos de trabajo de modelado hidráulico.
pyqgis_plugin.about: SIOSE2Manning es un complemento de QGIS que asigna valores de rugosidad de Manning a los polígonos de SIOSE AR utilizando la cobertura dominante (ID_COBERTURA_MAX) de la capa T_COMBINADA. Permite cargar datos de SIOSE AR desde un GeoPackage, seleccionar un Area de Interes directamente en el mapa, recortar la cartografía a dicha AOI, calcular areas de poligonos y generar una capa lista para su uso en modelacion hidraulica e hidrologica (por ejemplo HEC-RAS). Este desarrollo se ha beneficiado de aportes técnicos y discusiones compartidas por Antonio López y la comunidad SIG en LinkedIn, que ayudaron a orientar el enfoque metodológico, aunque el diseño e implementación del complemento han sido desarrollados de forma independiente por los autores.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Pedro Ivar y Hugo Alejandro Bohorquez Aliaga Villafuerte

pyqgis_plugin.name: PG2GPKG
pyqgis_plugin.description: Bidirectional bridge between PostgreSQL/PostGIS and GeoPackage: export databases to GPKG and import GPKG into PostGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
PG2GPKG moves data both ways between PostgreSQL/PostGIS and GeoPackage.
EXPORT (PostgreSQL → GeoPackage): • One GeoPackage per schema • Everything in a single GeoPackage • One GeoPackage per table • Automatic QGIS project export with datasource path rewriting
IMPORT (GeoPackage → PostgreSQL): • Multi-layer batch import with per-layer destination schema/table • Append, replace or create modes • Interactive field mapping (rename / exclude columns) • Optional reprojection to a target SRID • Fast COPY-based loading via GDAL (PG_USE_COPY)
General: • Tree/table-based layer selection with geometry info • Handles fid type conflicts, compressed project formats, and SSL mode normalization • Filters system tables automatically • Full Italian and English interface

pyqgis_plugin.name: Regio API Plugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: Estonian, Latvian and Lithuanian geocode, reverse geocode, routing and WMS basemap via Regio API (api.regio.ee). Includes a free trial (300 requests).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Provides address search with autocomplete, reverse geocode map-click tool, routing, and Regio Baltic WMS basemap. Works out of the box with a built-in free trial key (300 requests). Contact geospatial@regio.ee for a full API key.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Sort and Group Layers
pyqgis_plugin.description: Sort and group layers by file path, name, date, geometry, feature count, or file size
pyqgis_plugin.about: A QGIS plugin that adds "Sort Layers" and "Group Layers" submenus under the Layer menu. Sort layers by full file path, alphabetical name, file modification date, geometry type, feature count, or file size. When layers are already grouped, sorting operates within each group and also reorders the groups. Group layers automatically by geometry type or source folder path. Save and restore the original layer order. Created by Australis Asset Advisory Group.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Geomaticape Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Landsat C2 L1/L2, Sentinel-2, CBERS-04A, MODIS 09/11/12/13 scale factor per product independently, PCA, spectral indices, supervised + unsupervised classification, band extraction, vector geoprocessing, zonal statistics and multi-point sampling
pyqgis_plugin.about:
GeomaticaPE is a QGIS plugin developed by Geomatica Ambiental to automate preprocessing and analysis of multispectral satellite imagery and to support common geoprocessing tasks.
Tools organized into 7 groups:
[Conversion] - Factor Escala LandSat C2 L1 (SR + LST + PAN) - Factor escala Landsat C2 L2 (SR + LST) - Factor de escala Sentinel-2 L1C (10m) - Factor de escala Sentinel-2 L2A (10m) - Factor escala MODIS 09 (Reflectancia Superficial) - Factor escala MODIS 11 (LST C) - Factor escala MODIS 12 (Cobertura del Suelo) - Factor escala MODIS 13 (NDVI / EVI)
[Procesamiento] - ACP Multiespectral (cualquier satelite) - CBERS-04A Pansharpening Brovey 2m - Clasificacion no supervisada (K-Means / GMM / ISODATA / Birch) - Clasificacion supervisada y validacion - Definir celdas nulas - Extraer bandas de imagenes multiespectrales - Firma espectral (Landsat 5/7/8/9 / Sentinel-2 / ASTER) - Indices espectrales (NDVI, SAVI, EVI, NDWI, NBR, NDSI...) - Mosaico de imagenes - Reproyectar raster - Tasseled Cap (Brightness / Greenness / Wetness)
[PostProcesamiento] - Clasificar raster por rangos - Reclasificar raster (remapeo de valores) - Reporte clasificacion vectorial (area y graficos) - Reporte de clasificacion raster (area, porcentaje, estadisticas)
[Geoprocesamiento] - Calcular angulo de poligono - Crear poligonos a partir de tabla - Estadistica zonal raster (Excel/CSV) - Extraer valores puntuales de multiples raster - Poligono superpuesto propio - Secciones transversales
[Descarga GEE] - Descargar imagenes Landsat / Sentinel-2 - Descargar indices espectrales (GEE) - Firma espectral profesional (GEE)
[MDE] - Descargar MDE - Generar curvas de nivel intermedias - Generar elevaciones puntuales
COMPATIBILITY: - Qt5 (PyQt5) and Qt6 (PyQt6) via qgis.PyQt compatibility layer - QGIS 3.28 to 4.99
REQUIREMENTS - Python modules bundled with QGIS (no installation needed): - numpy (all tools) - GDAL / osgeo (all tools) - matplotlib (QGIS LTR 3.22+; supervised_classification, pca_satellite)
REQUIREMENTS - External modules NOT bundled with QGIS (must install): - scikit-learn REQUIRED by: Unsupervised Classification (KMeans, MiniBatchKMeans, GaussianMixture, Birch, StandardScaler), Supervised Classification (DecisionTree, RandomForest, NaiveBayes, MLP, KNN, train_test_split, classification_report), Multispectral PCA (PCA, StandardScaler, make_pipeline) - pandas REQUIRED by: Multispectral PCA (variance table), Create Polygons from Table (read CSV/TXT/XLS/XLSX) - openpyxl REQUIRED by: Raster Zonal Statistics (export .xlsx), Extract Point Values (export .xlsx), Classification Report (export .xlsx with charts), Create Polygons from Table (read .xlsx) - xgboost (Optional) REQUIRED by: Supervised Classification (XGBoost) - catboost (Optional) REQUIRED by: Supervised Classification (CatBoost) - earthengine-api REQUIRED by: GEE Descargar Imagenes, GEE Descargar Indices, GEE Firma Espectral, Descargar MDE
Install all external dependencies (run once): python -m pip install --upgrade scikit-learn pandas openpyxl xgboost catboost earthengine-api
Developed and maintained by: Geomatica Ambiental - www.geomatica.pe
Acknowledgments: - Point Sampling Tool by Borys Jurgiel (GPL v2+) - inspiration for the multi-raster point sampling tool. https://github.com/borysiasty/pointsamplingtool

pyqgis_plugin.name: Embed Legend
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Floating Legend & Advanced KMZ/MIF Thematic Export Tool for RF Engineers and GIS Analysts.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Embed Legend is the ultimate productivity booster for QGIS users, particularly in the Telecommunications and GIS sectors. It creates a live, draggable floating legend panel that stays on your map canvas. Key features include: * Interactive visibility toggle (click to hide/show layers with a strikethrough effect). * Multi-layer stacking with clear separators. * Real-time feature counts and percentage (%) statistics. * Professional KMZ (Google Earth) export with auto-embedded legend images on the screen. * Smart Labeling: Automatically detects SiteID columns for Sectoral/Polygon layers, keeping Drive Test (Points) and Grid geometries clean without text clutter. * Direct MapInfo MIF export with hardcoded thematics. Export thousands of complex RF data points (Drive Test, Covmo/MR/MDT, Gcell) cleanly and efficiently in less than a minute.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Layer Multiply Toggle
pyqgis_plugin.description: Toggle the Multiply blend mode for all or selected layers and groups with a single click.
pyqgis_plugin.about: (27.05.2026) Adds a toolbar button that toggles the Multiply blend mode for all layers or only the selected layers/groups. A clickable Multiply icon next to each layer in the layer tree toggles Multiply per layer. A dropdown menu on the toolbar button lets you show/hide the layer-tree icons on demand and reset everything (restore originals, remove icons, toggle off). Original blend modes are preserved and restored on toggling off, and the on/off state is stored per project. Compatible with QGIS 3.x (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Bearing Protractor
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive floating protractor and advanced azimuth/distance measurement tool for RF Site Audit and Network Planning.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Bearing Protractor is a must-have interactive floating tool for QGIS users, particularly in the Telecommunications, RF Engineering, and GIS planning sectors. It provides an on-screen, draggable protractor overlay designed to speed up cell planning and azimuth audits. Key features include: * Dynamic Multiple Bearings: Create and drag multiple sector antennas (needles) to simulate coverage direction and beamwidth. * Real-Time Distance Tracking: Automatically calculates real-world distances (Meters/Km) dynamically based on the map canvas CRS and scale. * Manual Measurement Ruler: Double-click to draw a temporary line to instantly check the azimuth and distance to neighbor sites. * Cell Footprint Generation: Export current sector configurations as physical polygon vector layers (Cell_Footprint) directly to the map canvas. * 1-Click Data Export: Instantly copy sector data (Azimuth, Beamwidth, Distance) to the clipboard in tabular format for easy pasting into spreadsheets or reports. * Persistent Settings: All visual customizations (ring size, colors, fonts, sector counts) are automatically saved across QGIS sessions. * Bilingual Support & Clean UI: Seamlessly switch between English and Indonesian, featuring an unobtrusive, transparent interface that doesn't block map visibility. Whether you are verifying physical tuning, doing site audits, or planning new macro cells, this tool replaces traditional static measurement plugins with a fluid, visual experience.

pyqgis_plugin.name: LAS to ENVI-met Tree Converter
pyqgis_plugin.description: Converts LAS/LAZ point clouds into ENVI‑met tree models with Leaf Area Density (LAD) calculation and A‑gs physiological parameterisation
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin provides a complete workflow to convert LiDAR point clouds (LAS/LAZ format) into 3D tree models suitable for the microclimate simulation software ENVI‑met. Users can interactively select a trunk point and define a region of interest, apply percentile‑based filtering to isolate tree points, and then scale, rotate, or translate the point cloud to match desired dimensions. The plugin voxelises the data at 1 m resolution and calculates Leaf Area Density (LAD) values using user‑selected reference voxels. Further refinements such as crown factor adjustment, trunk enhancement, LAD thresholding, and ground clearing are available. Physiological A‑gs parameters can be chosen from species presets or entered manually. The final tree can be exported as an ENVI‑met plant file (.txt) and optionally inserted directly into an existing project database. Designed for researchers and urban planners, the plugin bridges the gap between high‑resolution LiDAR data and microclimate modelling in ENVI‑met. Some of the tools in las2ENVImet require the Python libraries laspy, lazrs and matplotlib, which are not included in the default installation of QGIS. See the "Dependencies" section in the README file.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Netcad DNS Koordinat Donusum
pyqgis_plugin.description: Coordinate transformation using Netcad DNS files: Helmert, Affine and TIN methods.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin reads Netcad .dns transformation files and applies coordinate transformation to selected vector layers.
SUPPORTED METHODS: - Helmert (4 parameters): Isotropic scale + rotation + translation. Most common method. Minimum 2 control points required. - Affine (6 parameters): Different scale in E/N direction + shear. More flexible. Minimum 3 control points required. - TIN (Delaunay Triangulation): Local transformation per triangle. Residual = 0 at all control points (exact pass-through). Best accuracy for large areas. Minimum 3 control points required.
SUPPORTED DNS FILE TYPES: - Point-Based ($AMAT + $NOK): Parameters computed from control points via LSQ. - Matrix-Based ($AMAT only): Parameters read directly from $AMAT matrix.
QUALITY CONTROL: - Data Snooping (Baarda Test): Iteratively detects suspicious control points. - Normalized residuals (w-values) vs critical value comparison. - Error ellipses: sigma_E, sigma_N, sigma_P, semi-major/minor axes. - Residual vector and error ellipse layers can be added to the map.
MULTI-LAYER SUPPORT: - Multiple layers can be selected (Ctrl/Shift) and transformed in one step. - Option to transform in-place or create new layers with custom suffix.
REPORTING: - HTML report: Opens in browser with full CSS styling. - PDF report: Generated via QGIS WebEngine.
Compatible with QGIS 3.16+ and QGIS 4.x (Qt5/Qt6). scipy package required for TIN method.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Image Extractor
pyqgis_plugin.description: Clips and exports a basemap image and DEM raster to a vector AOI polygon extent, ready for 3D texture draping. Developed by Geocentric Environmental Inc. to streamline importing terrains in CSM 3D Vis(tm).
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Image Extractor automates the process of clipping a basemap (e.g. Google Satellite) and a DEM raster to a user-defined AOI polygon, producing georeferenced outputs ready for 3D texture draping workflows. Developed by Geocentric Environmental Inc. to streamline internal DEM and texture draping processes.
The tool renders the visible map canvas to a high-resolution image, applies a precise vector mask from the selected AOI layer, auto-crops to the opaque pixel boundary, and clips the DEM to the exact same geographic extent. Both outputs share identical spatial extents, eliminating skirt artifacts in 3D visualization software.
Outputs: - Tile__0__0.png — masked and cropped basemap image (PNG) - [Output Name].tif — DEM clipped to matching extent (GeoTIFF)
Inputs configured through a simple dialog: - Basemap layer (raster) - DEM layer (raster) - Cropping Extent layer (vector polygon) - Output folder and file name - Output CRS — recommended WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for broadest compatibility - Cropping layer CRS — CRS of the vector layer used for cropping - Basemap CRS — CRS of the basemap imagery (Google Satellite is typically Web Mercator, EPSG:3857)

pyqgis_plugin.name: Generalize Polygons
pyqgis_plugin.description: Topology-preserving polygon simplification using the weighted Visvalingam algorithm — no slivers, no gaps.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Reduces the vertex count of polygon layers while preserving shape and topology.
Shared borders between adjacent polygons are simplified exactly once, so both neighbours always receive the same simplified edge. This guarantees that no slivers, gaps, or overlaps are introduced — a property not provided by most standard simplification tools.
The algorithm is based on the weighted Visvalingam-Whyatt method as used in MapShaper (mbloch/mapshaper). Triangle areas are weighted by the angle at the centre vertex, so nearly-collinear points are removed first while geometrically significant vertices are protected.
You can find the button in QGIS in the menu Vector > Generalize Polygons... or use the tools panel.

pyqgis_plugin.about: SL: Vtičnik QNarcIS se povezuje z informacijskim sistemom za naravo - NarcIS, podpira napredno izvajanje prostorskih poizvedb, zagotavlja preprost dostop do biodiverzitetnih, naravovarstvenih in podpornih slojev. Razvit je bil v okviru projekta LIFE NarcIS (https://narcis.gov.si), dalje se razvija in nadgrajuje v okviru projekta SLO4D (https://www.gov.si/zbirke/projekti-in-programi/zeleni-slovenski-lokacijski-okvir-slo4d). Več informacij in navodila: https://github.com/the-tomazz/qnarcis --- EN: The QNarcIS plugin connects to the NarcIS nature information system, supports advanced spatial queries, and provides simple access to biodiversity, nature-conservation, and supporting layers. With the "Send layer" functionality, these queries can be executed directly in the NarcIS portal. The plugin also includes user instructions and announcements of current updates from the GIS forum in the NarcIS portal. QNarcIS was developed within the framework of the LIFE NarcIS project (https://narcis.gov.si) and continues to be developed and upgraded as part of the SLO4D project (https://www.gov.si/zbirke/projekti-in-programi/zeleni-slovenski-lokacijski-okvir-slo4d). More details and documentation: https://github.com/the-tomazz/qnarcis

pyqgis_plugin.name: SIOSE2CN
pyqgis_plugin.description: Calcula P0 y Número de Curva (CN) a partir de SIOSE, pendiente e IGME para flujos de trabajo hidrológicos e hidráulicos en España Peninsular.
pyqgis_plugin.about: SIOSE2CN es un complemento de QGIS que calcula automáticamente el umbral de escorrentía (P0) y el Número de Curva (CN) a partir de coberturas del suelo SIOSE-AR, pendiente del terreno derivada de un MDT, y grupos hidrológicos obtenidos de la capa de permeabilidad del IGME (escala 1:200.000). El resultado es un raster NC_CURSO listo para su uso en modelos lluvia-escorrentía como HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS 2D u otros. Válido para España Peninsular. Soporta SIOSE-AR 2016, 2017, 2018 y 2020. La capa de permeabilidad IGME puede descargarse automáticamente, cargarse desde archivo local o conectarse mediante el servidor ArcGIS REST del IGME. Este desarrollo ha contado con la colaboración de Antonio López Espinazo, que aportó la metodología y la capa maestra de permeabilidad IGME utilizada en el cálculo.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Pedro Ivar y Hugo Alejandro Bohorquez

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoPoint Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: Creates point vector layers from data sources with coordinate fields (lat/lon). Supports OGR/GDAL URLs, Google Sheets, GeoJSON, WFS and existing QGIS layers. Custom CSV separator and field options. Bilingual ITA/EN interface. Compatible with QGIS 3 and QGIS 4.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoPoint Manager lets you create point vector layers from any data source that contains latitude/longitude fields. It supports OGR/GDAL URLs, Google Sheets (via CSV export), GeoJSON, WFS services, and existing QGIS layers. Custom CSV separator (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, custom) and record/field options (skip rows, decimal comma, trim fields, discard empty fields). pyqgis_plugin.name: RasterStatsPlus
pyqgis_plugin.description: Calculates extended statistics on raster layers, displays results in a table, generates histograms, and allows exporting to TXT/CSV and PNG/SVG, providing advanced raster analysis with integrated visualization tools.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Raster-derived statistics describe both the spatial structure and the distribution of pixel values. The Cell size X and Cell size Y parameters indicate pixel dimensions in both directions of the reference system, defining the dataset's spatial resolution. Min and Max represent the lowest and highest values in the raster, while the Range expresses the total span as the difference between them. The Mean provides a central measure of the distribution, complemented by Variance and Stddev (standard deviation), which quantify data dispersion. The Median represents the central value and is less sensitive to outliers, while the p5, p25, p75, and p95 percentiles identify key distribution thresholds, useful for detecting extreme values or data concentration. The IQR (Interquartile Range), calculated as p75 − p25, measures 'robust' variability by ignoring extremes. Shape indices like Skewness and Kurtosis describe asymmetry and the 'peakedness' of the distribution, highlighting anomalous tails or peaks. Finally, the Coeff_var (coefficient of variation) expresses relative variability by relating the standard deviation to the mean, making it ideal for comparing rasters with different scales.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GTFS 2 GIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Visualize and analyze GTFS transit data in QGIS with styled layers, dashboards, and real-time vehicle tracking.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A comprehensive QGIS plugin for loading, visualizing, and analyzing GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) and GTFS-RT data. Features include: styled route and stop layers, real-time vehicle tracking with bearing-based icons, frequency heatmaps, population coverage analysis (IBGE), transit desert detection, network isochrones, and a dynamic real-time dashboard.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Ledger
pyqgis_plugin.description: IT: Controllo di versione stile Git per progetti QGIS: diff geometrici, rollback e sincronizzazione multi-cloud. / EN: Git-like version control for QGIS projects: geometric diffs, rollback and multi-cloud sync.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
============================================================ ITALIANO ============================================================ QGIS Ledger — Versioning di Livello Enterprise per QGIS Sistema di tracciamento storico e sincronizzazione cloud progettato per l'integrità dei dati spaziali, senza dipendenze esterne. Ottimizzato per QGIS 3.x e QGIS 4 (Qt6).
FUNZIONALITÀ PRINCIPALI: - Architettura a Snapshot: Commit atomici di layer e progetti in SQLite locale. - Diff Semantico-Visuale: Analisi geometrica delle differenze tra versioni. - Rollback Deterministico: Ripristino istantaneo di dati e stili. - Sincronizzazione Cloud: Supporto nativo per Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive e GDrive. - Merge Wizard: Gestione conflitti in split-screen.
============================================================ ENGLISH ============================================================ QGIS Ledger — Enterprise-Grade Version Control for QGIS Comprehensive historical tracking and cloud synchronization engine engineered for geospatial data integrity, operating entirely dependency-free across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4 (Qt6).
CORE FEATURES: - Snapshot Architecture: Atomic commits of layers and projects in local SQLite. - Semantic Visual Diff: Geometric analysis of differences between versions. - Deterministic Rollback: Instant restoration of data and styling. - Cloud Synchronization: Native support for Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive, and GDrive. - Merge Wizard: Split-screen conflict resolution.

pyqgis_plugin.name: BKompV Rechner
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automated ecological impact assessment according to BKompV.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Dieses Plugin automatisiert die Eingriffs-Ausgleichs-Bilanzierung nach BKompV. Es bietet ein Einzelbaum-Modul, Habitat-Boni (+3 WE) und ein intelligentes Projektions-Management. This tool reduces manual processing time and minimizes errors in environmental impact assessments, ensuring high-quality results for official approval processes.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Palette Pilot
pyqgis_plugin.description: Style vector layers in a snap — ramps, saved colours, and full layer styles (point, line, polygon).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Apply built-in or saved colour ramps to graduated/categorized layers, save single-symbol colours, and save/load full layer styles by geometry type. Copy path and open style folder. Styles stay in QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Qgis2OnlineMap
pyqgis_plugin.description: One-click web map hosting. Share your QGIS, qgis2web, and Qgis2threejs projects online instantly.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Qgis2OnlineMap is a zero-config hosting bridge for QGIS. Securely publish 2D and 3D maps to the cloud and manage them via a professional dashboard. Optimized for secured and rapid stakeholder sharing. Compatible with QGIS 3.x and 4.0.

pyqgis_plugin.name: RecoverLand
pyqgis_plugin.description: Local GIS data audit and recovery: automatic capture, search and restoration of modifications
pyqgis_plugin.about: RecoverLand automatically captures every modification (attribute, geometry, deletion) in a local SQLite journal, then allows you to search, compare and restore previous states of features.

pyqgis_plugin.name: mutant.kiwi Imagery Explorer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Explore 621,728 New Zealand historical aerial and near-infrared imagery sheets. Click the map to query intersecting layers and load COGs directly.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A point-and-click explorer for New Zealand aerial imagery served from https://registry.opendata.aws/nz-imagery/ Click anywhere on the map to find all imagery sheets covering that location, then double-click any result to stream the Cloud-Optimised GeoTIFF directly into QGIS. Supports RGB aerial, near-infrared (auto CIR false-colour), and satellite imagery. Data sourced from LINZ / nz-imagery S3 archive.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoSpreadsheet
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create QGIS layers from spreadsheet files (*.ods, *.xls, *.xlsx)
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoSpreadsheet lets you load spreadsheet files (*.ods, *.xls, *.xlsx) into QGIS as vector layers. It adds entries in the Plugins menu and Layer > Add Layer menu, plus a toolbar button that opens the same dialog. The plugin can use the first row as header, skip rows, and optionally create geometry from X/Y fields. When accepted, it creates a GDAL VRT file in the same folder as the source spreadsheet and loads it into QGIS through OGR. If an existing VRT is found, the dialog reuses its saved settings. No additional dependencies are required.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TranslationBuilder
pyqgis_plugin.description: Scans a QGIS plugin and extracts all translatable strings from Python and UI files, generating TS and QM translation files without using lupdate. Includes automatic detection of lrelease, multi-platform support, and integrated Qt Linguist launcher.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A modern TS/QM generator for QGIS 4 plugins. Extracts translations from Python and UI files, builds TS/QM without lupdate, detects lrelease automatically, and integrates Qt Linguist.

pyqgis_plugin.name: RTH PROJECT
pyqgis_plugin.description: O RTH PROJECT é um plugin QGIS voltado para agricultura de precisão e sensoriamento remoto, reunindo mais de 33 ferramentas ativas que cobrem todo o fluxo de trabalho, da aquisição de imagens de satélite até a exportação para equipamentos de campo. Por meio do RTH API Browser, o plugin integra catálogos STAC do INPE, Planetary Computer e AWS Element84, permitindo buscar, visualizar e baixar cenas de Sentinel-2, Landsat, CBERS e Amazônia-1 diretamente no QGIS, com reprojeção automática para o datum UTM regional e ajuste de contraste aplicado na abertura. Para análise de talhões, é possível calcular índices de vegetação como NDVI, EVI, SAVI, MSAVI e NDWI — ou fórmula personalizada — lendo apenas a região do polígono selecionado via COG, sem necessidade de baixar a cena completa. No contexto agrícola, o plugin oferece geração de linhas de plantio ou colheita com suporte a curvas, análise de azimute e métricas de regularidade das linhas existentes, criação de carreadores e exportação de planos de manejo para oito marcas de monitores agrícolas, incluindo formato ISO-XML para John Deere. Para operações com drones, estão disponíveis planejador de missão com cálculo automático de GSD e sobreposição, estimativa de baterias e tempo de voo com presets de modelos reais, exportação para Litchi, Mission Planner e KMZ, geração de ortomosaicos com GDAL e criação de MDEs e MDTs a partir de tiles de elevação ou nuvens de pontos LAS/LAZ. O plugin também centraliza o acesso a bases geográficas públicas brasileiras de órgãos como FUNAI, ANA, ICMBio, IBAMA, INCRA e ANEEL via catálogo WMS/WFS integrado, além de permitir o download de dados de desmatamento PRODES e modelos digitais de elevação de fontes como SRTM, Copernicus e AW3D. Para aumentar a produtividade no dia a dia, conta com aplicação de estilos e layouts de impressão com um clique, ciclo automático de visibilidade entre camadas por grupo, cálculo de área em hectares com projeção regional automática, importação e exportação de CSV de pontos GPS, conversão de pontos em polígonos via Concave Hull, revisor de polígonos com navegação automática, integração com Google Earth Pro e exportação para File Geodatabase compatível com ArcGIS. Completam o conjunto quatro aplicativos Google Earth Engine acessíveis diretamente pelo menu, voltados para análise temporal, séries de vegetação, dados climáticos e monitoramento de desmatamento.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The RTH PROJECT is a QGIS plugin focused on precision agriculture and remote sensing, bringing together more than 33 active tools that cover the entire workflow, from satellite image acquisition to field equipment export. Through the RTH API Browser, the plugin integrates STAC catalogs from INPE, Planetary Computer and AWS Element84, allowing users to search, visualize and download scenes from Sentinel-2, Landsat, CBERS and Amazônia-1 directly within QGIS, with automatic reprojection to the regional UTM datum and contrast enhancement applied on load. For field analysis, vegetation indices such as NDVI, EVI, SAVI, MSAVI and NDWI — or a custom formula — can be computed by reading only the selected polygon region via COG, with no need to download the full scene. On the agricultural side, the plugin provides generation of planting or harvesting lines with curve support, azimuth and regularity metric analysis of existing lines, headland creation, and export of management plans to eight brands of agricultural monitors, including ISO-XML format for John Deere. For drone operations, it includes a mission planner with automatic GSD and overlap calculation, battery count and flight time estimation with real drone model presets, export to Litchi, Mission Planner and KMZ, orthomosaic generation via GDAL, and DEM and DTM creation from elevation tiles or LAS/LAZ point clouds. The plugin also centralizes access to Brazilian public geographic databases from agencies such as FUNAI, ANA, ICMBio, IBAMA, INCRA and ANEEL through an integrated WMS/WFS catalog, and supports downloading PRODES deforestation data and digital elevation models from sources including SRTM, Copernicus and AW3D. For daily productivity, it offers one-click style and print layout application, automatic layer visibility cycling by group, area calculation in hectares with regional projection, GPS point CSV import and export, point-to-polygon conversion via Concave Hull, a polygon reviewer with automatic navigation, Google Earth Pro integration and export to ArcGIS-compatible File Geodatabase. Rounding out the toolset are four Google Earth Engine applications accessible directly from the menu, designed for temporal analysis, vegetation time series, climate data and deforestation monitoring.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGarage
pyqgis_plugin.description: Modular app-hosting framework for QGIS with per-app uv/pixi environments, Processing integration, and a unified dashboard for isolated mini-tools.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGarage is a plugin-within-a-plugin framework for QGIS that installs, manages, and runs isolated mini-tools from a single dashboard. Version 2 adds dual uv/pixi backends for app environments, asynchronous environment preparation during installs, clearer setup error reporting, Processing Toolbox integration for declarative apps, richer scaffolding with backend selection and custom destinations, and bundled TestToolbox examples for both uv and pixi workflows. Install the plugin from the QGIS Plugin Manager, then configure uv and/or pixi in QGarage settings based on the apps you want to run.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ArcGIS ImageServer Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Download raster tiles from ArcGIS ImageServer REST services and create Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs)
pyqgis_plugin.about: Download raster tiles from ArcGIS ImageServer REST services at their native resolution and assemble them into Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs). Supports large-area downloads via a draw-on-canvas bbox tool and parallel tile fetching. Includes a dock widget for browsing and selecting services, plus Processing algorithms for scripted and batch workflows. Zero external dependencies — requires only QGIS and its bundled GDAL. Compatible with QGIS 3.28+ (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6). Ships with GIS Steiermark pre-configured; custom servers can be added.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TKGM Parsel Sorgulama
pyqgis_plugin.description: TKGM CBS API üzerinden parsel sorgulama, geometri görüntüleme ve harita tıklama ile parsel bulma. / Parcel query and geometry display via TKGM CBS API.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Bu eklenti TKGM (Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü) CBS API'sini kullanarak parsel sorgulama yapar. İl/İlçe/Mahalle/Ada/Parsel ile ya da haritaya tıklayarak parsel geometrisini QGIS katmanına ekler. / This plugin queries parcels using the TKGM CBS API and adds geometries to QGIS layers.
